Let us consider the map $\psi:[0,+\infty)\to [0,+\infty)$ defined by
$$
\psi(s):=\int_0^s \frac{1}{\sqrt{2{\mathcal H}(\xi)}}d\xi,\qquad
{\mathcal H}(s):=\int_s^{+\infty} h(\xi)d\xi,
\,\,\quad\text{for $s>0$.}
$$
